title: Gaspard's age and death after Summers' father
summary: Gaspard died at about 86 shortly after Summers' father; the family had moved to New Orleans in 1910.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Good English. He's a man about, well, he oughta been about 80 or something too now. I guess he would, oh yeah. About 86, you know.
Must have died at least three years ago. He must have been about three years ago he'd been dead.
He died a little after my dad. September, early in September. I think it was. A little after my daddy died. Your daddy's not been there no more.
It'd be three years. About four years this year. Oh.

Thanksgiving, eh, Julian? Four years, Thanksgiving. And Donald's on the bill? No, no, he died here. Right here, he lived here then. He lived here. He just went up there, you said, to play with the band. Played the band. He moved here then the same time you did, of course.
You were just a boy. Oh yeah, when we moved here, I was coming up with him.
